items.title: Euclid Transactional study highlights W&I market unprofitability and pricing reset
items.summary: Euclid Transactional’s fourth annual Global W&I Claims Study reveals that accelerating large-loss severity and falling rates have driven an unprofitable market cycle.

items.title: NCSC warns of unprecedented rise in UK cyber incidents despite drop in serious attacks
items.summary: The National Cyber Security Centre has reported a rise in overall cyber attacks against UK organisations while warning that AI and unpatched vulnerabilities could drive a sharp increase in incidents.

items.title: Scottish Widows confirms UK venture capital investments through LTAF
items.summary: Scottish Widows has deployed its first venture capital investments via its long-term asset fund to connect workplace pension savings with UK technology and science companies.

items.title: Albemarle Street Partners launches Core ETF Model Portfolio range
items.summary: Albemarle Street Partners has introduced five actively managed ETF model portfolios with ongoing charges figures ranging between 0.25% and 0.35%.

items.title: BlackRock Greater Europe announces strategic overhaul following underperformance
items.summary: BlackRock Greater Europe has introduced a package of strategic initiatives aimed at boosting the trust's appeal after trailing its reference index.

items.title: TPR warns DC consolidation may diminish role for member-nominated trustees
items.summary: The Pensions Regulator has highlighted potential governance challenges for member voices as defined contribution pension schemes consolidate.
